qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Professional design, engineering, and environmental consultancy operates as a billable-hours people business with low barriers to entry and intense competition from global peers (WSP, AECOM, Jacobs). Lacks durable pricing power, resulting in sub-hurdle multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (~7-8%) and high susceptibility to wage inflation and project cancellations.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype 'None' & ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Design and engineering consultancy is a billable-hours professional services business with low switching barriers and high wage sensitivity, generating sub-hurdle GAAP ROIC (~7-8%).
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated GAAP operating margin averages 6-7% and multi-cycle GAAP ROIC remains around 7-8%, below the 12% threshold. Highly fragmented competitive environment against global engineering consultancies with zero proprietary lock-in.
